components.notes: Organizers: every listed organizer in one CatchTable on CatchPaneLayout wide-table with real totals from adminListOrganizerDirectory; CatchWorkspaceHeader carries the views (all, live, unclaimed, hidden), the city, kind, claim-waiting and Mine chips and search. It replaces the Organizer Publishing directory.

One organizer in the CatchPaneLayout reading pattern with CatchPageTabBar tabs Overview, Page, Events, Sales, Money and History, read from adminGetOrganizerOverview, with CatchMetaRow facts and the CatchSection timeline journey; the Page tab hosts the Organizer Publishing editor for this organizer; its Page tab edits the public page.

Lazy live route wrapper owns the Organizers directory and organizer page controllers and keeps the claims review reachable until the Inbox decides claims; deterministic prop-driven coverage remains on route_organizer_directory and route_organizer_page.
